# Simulate data from model.
# Then fit model to data.
# Then make observations more noisy / sparse and observe what happens to the model fit.
# Also, fit model on some time steps and make predictions for the next steps.

```{r}
# find common serotypes and clusters (>1% in start population)
PPsero_startpop6 <- readRDS("PPsero_startpop6.rds")
freq_clust <- which(rowSums(PPsero_startpop6)>(sum(PPsero_startpop6)/100))
freq_sero <- which(colSums(PPsero_startpop6)>(sum(PPsero_startpop6)/100))
length(freq_clust) # 23
length(freq_sero) # 21


set.seed(13)
dt_test <- 1/12
# use all directly original
Genotypes_test_matrix <- readRDS("Genotypes_test_matrix.rds")
delta_test <- readRDS("delta_test.rds")
migMatr_test_mtx <- readRDS("migMatr_test_mtx.rds")

gene_no_test <- length(delta_test)

# generate vacc types
vaccTypes_test_mtx1 <- readRDS(file = "SeroVT.rds")
vaccTypes_test_mtx <- vaccTypes_test_mtx1[freq_sero]


Pop_ini_test_mtx <- matrix(PPsero_startpop6[freq_clust, freq_sero], nrow = length(freq_clust), ncol = length(freq_sero))
Pop_ini_test_mtx <- Pop_ini_test_mtx * 1000
Pop_ini_test_mtx <- matrix(PPsero_startpop6[freq_clust, freq_sero], nrow = length(freq_clust), ncol = length(freq_sero))

# test initialising with 3 instead of 1
Pop_ini_test_mtx_ini3 <- Pop_ini_test_mtx
Pop_ini_test_mtx_ini3[which(Pop_ini_test_mtx == 1, arr.ind = TRUE)] <- 3

# test initialising with 10 instead of 1
Pop_ini_test_mtx_ini10 <- Pop_ini_test_mtx
Pop_ini_test_mtx_ini10[which(Pop_ini_test_mtx == 1, arr.ind = TRUE)] <- 10

# test initialising with 0 instead of 1
Pop_ini_test_mtx_ini0 <- Pop_ini_test_mtx
Pop_ini_test_mtx_ini0[which(Pop_ini_test_mtx == 1, arr.ind = TRUE)] <- 0


sim_data_IniRobust <- function(start_population){
  PPxSero_testparams <- list(dt = dt_test, species_no = species_no_test, sero_no = sero_no_test, gene_no = gene_no_test, Pop_ini = start_population, Pop_eq = rowSums(start_population), capacity = sum(start_population), Genotypes = Genotypes_test_matrix, sigma_f = log(0.0345), prop_f = 0.3, delta = (delta_test), m = log(0.0133), migVec = migMatr_test_mtx, vaccTypes = vaccTypes_test_mtx, v = 0.0814, vacc_time = 4)


WFmodel_ppxSero <- WF_PPxSero$new(pars = PPxSero_testparams,
                         time = 0,
                         n_particles = 10L,
                         n_threads = 4L,
                         seed = 1L, deterministic = TRUE)
#WFmodel_ppxSero$run(1)

simMean_clust <- rowMeans(WFmodel_ppxSero$run(0)[2:(species_no_test+1),])
simMean_all <- rowMeans(WFmodel_ppxSero$run(0)[-(1:(species_no_test+1)),])
simMean_matrix <- matrix(simMean_all, ncol = sero_no_test, nrow = species_no_test, byrow = FALSE)
simMean_sero <- colSums(simMean_matrix)


simulated_data <- list()
for (i in 1:20) {
  simMean_all <- rowMeans(WFmodel_ppxSero$run(i)[-(1:(species_no_test+1)),])
  simMean_matrix <- matrix(simMean_all, ncol = sero_no_test, nrow = species_no_test, byrow = FALSE)
  simulated_data[[i]] <- simMean_matrix
}
simulated_data_over_time_short_clust <- sapply(simulated_data, rowSums)

simulated_data_over_time_short_clust_df <- as.data.frame(simulated_data_over_time_short_clust)

simulated_data_long <- list()
simulated_sum_data_long <- list()
list_of_particle_list <- list()
WFmodel_ppxSero <- WF_PPxSero$new(pars = PPxSero_testparams,
                         time = 0,
                         n_particles = 10L,
                         n_threads = 4L,
                         seed = 1L, deterministic = TRUE)
for (i in 0:240) {
  simMean_all <- rowMeans(WFmodel_ppxSero$run(i)[-(1:(species_no_test+1)),])
  simMean_matrix <- matrix(simMean_all, ncol = sero_no_test, nrow = species_no_test, byrow = FALSE)
  simulated_data_long[[i+1]] <- simMean_matrix
  simSum_all <- rowSums(WFmodel_ppxSero$run(i)[-(1:(species_no_test+1)),])
  simSum_matrix <- matrix(simSum_all, ncol = sero_no_test, nrow = species_no_test, byrow = FALSE)
  simulated_sum_data_long[[i+1]] <- simSum_matrix
  
  #for (j in 1:10) {
  #  #list_of_particle_list[j][[i+1]] <- matrix(WFmodel_ppxSero$run(i)[-(1:(species_no_test+1)),j], ncol = sero_no_test, nrow = species_no_test, byrow = FALSE)
  #  empty_matr <- matrix(NA, nrow = species_no_test, ncol = 10)
  #  empty_matr[,j] <- WFmodel_ppxSero$run(i)[(2:(species_no_test+1)),j]
  #}
  list_of_particle_list[[i+1]] <-  WFmodel_ppxSero$run(i)[(2:(species_no_test+1)),]
}
simulated_data_over_time_clust <- sapply(simulated_data_long, rowSums)
simulated_data_over_time_clust_df <- as.data.frame(simulated_data_over_time_clust)

simulated_data_over_time_filtered <- simulated_data_over_time_clust[,((1:20)*12)+1]
simulated_data_over_time_filtered
}



simulated_data_over_time_filtered_ini1 <- sim_data_IniRobust(Pop_ini_test_mtx)
simulated_data_over_time_filtered_ini3 <- sim_data_IniRobust(Pop_ini_test_mtx_ini3)
simulated_data_over_time_filtered_ini10 <- sim_data_IniRobust(Pop_ini_test_mtx_ini10)
simulated_data_over_time_filtered_ini0 <- sim_data_IniRobust(Pop_ini_test_mtx_ini0)


simulated_data_over_time_filtered_ini1_rel <- simulated_data_over_time_filtered_ini1/colSums(simulated_data_over_time_filtered_ini1) * 100
simulated_data_over_time_filtered_ini3_rel <- simulated_data_over_time_filtered_ini3/colSums(simulated_data_over_time_filtered_ini3) * 100
simulated_data_over_time_filtered_ini10_rel <- simulated_data_over_time_filtered_ini10/colSums(simulated_data_over_time_filtered_ini10) * 100
simulated_data_over_time_filtered_ini0_rel <- simulated_data_over_time_filtered_ini0/colSums(simulated_data_over_time_filtered_ini0) * 100

simulated_data_over_time_filtered_ini1_df <- tibble::rownames_to_column(as.data.frame(simulated_data_over_time_filtered_ini1_rel), var = "species")
simulated_data_over_time_filtered_ini3_df <- tibble::rownames_to_column(as.data.frame(simulated_data_over_time_filtered_ini3_rel), var = "species")
simulated_data_over_time_filtered_ini10_df <- tibble::rownames_to_column(as.data.frame(simulated_data_over_time_filtered_ini10_rel), var = "species")
simulated_data_over_time_filtered_ini0_df <- tibble::rownames_to_column(as.data.frame(simulated_data_over_time_filtered_ini0_rel), var = "species")

names(simulated_data_over_time_filtered_ini1_df) <- c("species", as.character(1:20))
names(simulated_data_over_time_filtered_ini3_df) <- c("species", as.character(1:20))
names(simulated_data_over_time_filtered_ini10_df) <- c("species", as.character(1:20))
names(simulated_data_over_time_filtered_ini0_df) <- c("species", as.character(1:20))
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)

plot_species_over_time <- function(df1, df2, df3, 
                                   id_col = "species",
                                   df_labels = c("Group 1", "Group 2", "Group 3")) {
  
  # Helper to pivot one dataframe to long format and tag it
  prep_df <- function(df, label) {
    df %>%
      pivot_longer(
        cols = -all_of(id_col),
        names_to = "time",
        values_to = "value"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        time     = factor(time, levels = unique(time)),
        dataframe = label
      )
  }
  
  df_long <- bind_rows(
    prep_df(df1, df_labels[1]),
    prep_df(df2, df_labels[2]),
    prep_df(df3, df_labels[3])
  ) %>%
    mutate(dataframe = factor(dataframe, levels = df_labels))
  
  # Build a wide-format dataframe for the ribbon (needs ymin and ymax per species/time)
  df_ribbon <- df_long %>%
    filter(dataframe %in% c(df_labels[1], df_labels[3])) %>%
    group_by(.data[[id_col]], time) %>%
    summarise(
      ymin = min(value),
      ymax = max(value),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # Generate and shuffle the turbo palette
  n_species        <- length(unique(df_long[[id_col]]))
  turbo_colours    <- viridisLite::viridis(n_species, option = "turbo")
  shuffled_colours <- sample(turbo_colours)
  
  ggplot() +
    # Ribbon layer (shading between df1 and df3)
    geom_ribbon(
      data = df_ribbon,
      aes(
        x    = time,
        ymin = ymin,
        ymax = ymax,
        fill = .data[[id_col]],
        group = .data[[id_col]]
      ),
      alpha = 0.15,  # adjust transparency here
      colour = NA
    ) +
    # Line layer
    geom_line(
      data = df_long,
      aes(
        x        = time,
        y        = value,
        colour   = .data[[id_col]],
        linetype = dataframe,
        group    = interaction(.data[[id_col]], dataframe)
      ),
      linewidth = 0.8
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = df_long,
      aes(
        x      = time,
        y      = value,
        colour = .data[[id_col]],
        group  = interaction(.data[[id_col]], dataframe)
      ),
      size = 1.5
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = shuffled_colours) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = shuffled_colours) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c("solid", "dashed", "dotted")) +
    guides(fill = "none") +  # suppress redundant fill legend
    labs(
      title    = "GPSC frequencies over time",
      x        = "Time (Years)",
      y        = "Percentage",
      colour   = id_col,
      linetype = "Dataset"
    ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x     = element_text(hjust = 1, size = 14), 
    axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 14),                          
    axis.title      = element_text(size = 16),                          
    legend.text     = element_text(size = 12),                          
    legend.title    = element_text(size = 13),                          
    legend.position = "right"
  )
}


plot_species_over_time(
  simulated_data_over_time_filtered_ini0_df, simulated_data_over_time_filtered_ini1_df, simulated_data_over_time_filtered_ini10_df,
  id_col     = "species",
  df_labels  = c("Ini0", "Ini1", "Ini10") 
)

plot_species_over_time(
  simulated_data_over_time_filtered_ini1_df, simulated_data_over_time_filtered_ini3_df, simulated_data_over_time_filtered_ini10_df,
  id_col     = "species",
  df_labels  = c("Ini1", "Ini3", "Ini10") 
)
```
